theorem: For any observed proper subset of the five-nibble domain with all outputs zero, f0(x)=0 and f1(x)=1 only for the first unobserved input x*, otherwise zero, agree on all observations. With group action simultaneous 4-bit cyclic rotation of all five input nibbles and rotation of the 4-bit output, f0 is equivariant but f1 is not: at x*, f1(Rx*) is 0 or 1 whereas Rf1(x*)=2.
scope: Constructive witness applies to the explicitly zero-labelled partial-input subcase, not arbitrary label patterns or a restricted causal grammar. It does not rule out learning useful causal invariants with structural assumptions; those assumptions must be declared and controlled.
